basics.name: Johnathan Yesid Silva Parra
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Mobile Architect
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience specializing in cross-platform (Flutter, Xamarin, NativeScript, React Native) and native (Android/iOS) mobile development. Expert in designing scalable software architectures (Clean Architecture and Hexagonal Architecture), implementing CI/CD pipelines with AWS, Azure, and Bitrise, and building secure, enterprise-grade solutions for the financial and retail industries. Passionate about performance optimization, software quality, and delivering high-impact user experiences.

work.name: EPAM Systems
work.summary: Develop enterprise-grade mobile solutions for the financial industry, driving scalable architectures, CI/CD automation, DevSecOps practices, and the integration of Generative AI tools to improve engineering productivity. Contribute to software quality through automated testing, performance optimization, and engineering best practices. Also serve as Backup Technical Lead, supporting architecture decisions, technical mentoring, and team coordination.
highlights: Served as Backup Technical Lead, supporting architecture decisions, technical mentoring, and engineering coordination across the team.
Increased automated test coverage from 40% to 93%, significantly improving software quality and reducing production regressions.
Configured and integrated Generative AI solutions using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), automating development workflows and improving team productivity.
Designed and implemented AWS-based CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, testing, and continuous deployments.
Contributed to the evolution of Itaú Trader, supporting its growth from 5 to 67 corporate customers.
Helped the team achieve 85% of its strategic OKRs through continuous delivery of high-impact initiatives.

work.name: Tres Astronautas
work.summary: Contributed to the design and development of a multi-tenant SaaS platform for the FinTech industry, focused on enterprise B2B solutions. Participated in architecture definition, deployment automation, and cloud service integration to build a scalable, secure, and organization-ready platform.
highlights: Designed and implemented a multi-tenant SaaS architecture, ensuring data isolation and scalability across multiple organizations.
Optimized Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to automate build, testing, and deployment processes.
Designed and integrated Firebase services, including Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and supporting infrastructure.
Developed Cloud Functions for authentication, authorization, and user management, strengthening backend security and business logic.

work.name: Apex Global Mobility
work.summary: Contributed to the evolution of enterprise B2B and B2C mobile solutions for CBC, modernizing application architecture, improving performance, and automating delivery pipelines. Played a key role in redesigning the loyalty platform, supporting international expansion, and serving as Backup Technical Lead.
highlights: Served as Backup Technical Lead, contributing to architecture decisions, technical mentoring, code reviews, and release coordination.
Led the publication of mobile applications to Google Play and the Apple App Store, managing release processes and production stabilization.
Contributed to the complete redesign of the Loyalty platform, enabling business goals planned for year-end to be achieved months ahead of schedule.
Supported the international expansion of the platform from 5 to 17 countries by adapting the solution for multinational operations.
Migrated the mobile ecosystem to a monorepo architecture, improving maintainability, scalability, and code reuse.
Implemented Bitrise CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, testing, and mobile deployments.
Received a performance bonus in recognition of technical contributions and successful delivery of strategic objectives.

work.name: Yalutec
work.summary: Contributed to the frontend development of an enterprise loyalty platform built with Flutter Web. Focused on delivering responsive user experiences, reusable components, and a scalable architecture for rewards management and customer engagement.
highlights: Developed frontend features using Flutter Web for an enterprise loyalty platform.
Built responsive interfaces for rewards, points management, and redemption workflows.
Created reusable UI components to improve consistency, maintainability, and development efficiency.
Collaborated within cross-functional Agile teams to deliver new features through continuous iterations.

work.name: Venko
work.summary: Led the design, development, and evolution of mobile solutions across industries including digital identity, healthcare, enterprise productivity, and property management. Defined software architectures, provided technical consulting, and led cross-platform development using Flutter, Kotlin, and OpenCV while growing and mentoring the mobile engineering team.
highlights: Led end-to-end mobile projects, from requirements gathering and architecture design to production deployment and long-term maintenance.
Scaled the Mobile team from 1 to 4 engineers through mentoring, technical leadership, and code reviews.
Managed the publication and maintenance of all company mobile applications on Google Play and the Apple App Store.
Led the redesign of Firmese, contributing to its evolution and recognition within the Microsoft for Startups program.
Represented Venko in technical meetings with strategic clients, leading discovery sessions, solution architecture, and technology consulting.
Delivered solutions for organizations such as Pensemos and Universidad Pontificia Bolivariana's Legal Clinic, tailoring products to business-specific requirements.
Designed enterprise solutions using Flutter, Kotlin, and OpenCV for automation, document recognition, and digital productivity.
Improved application architecture, maintainability, scalability, and overall software quality across multiple products.

work.name: Actions Tracker S.L.
work.summary: Developed IvAdventure, an Android IoT platform focused on monitoring, automation, and intelligent control of connected devices using BLE and Wi-Fi. Integrated ESP32-based hardware while implementing telemetry, geolocation, critical event management, and offline synchronization capabilities.
highlights: Developed Android integrations with ESP32 devices using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Wi-Fi.
Implemented Over-the-Air (OTA) firmware updates for IoT devices.
Designed data synchronization and configuration modules using Room for local persistence and backend services for cloud synchronization.
Built advanced geolocation capabilities, including geofencing and marine buoy monitoring.
Implemented real-time event detection for accident alerts, panic button activation, and asset monitoring.
Contributed to a scalable IoT platform supporting boats, vehicles, motorcycles, trains, and aircraft.
Developed the application primarily in Java while introducing Kotlin modules as part of the modernization effort.

work.name: High Developer
work.summary: Started my professional career developing enterprise mobile applications across multiple industries, evolving from native Android development (Java/Kotlin) to iOS (Objective-C/Swift), Xamarin, NativeScript, and Flutter. Built a strong foundation in software architecture, cloud integration, and cross-platform application development.
highlights: Developed native Android applications using Java and Kotlin throughout the complete software development lifecycle.
Contributed to iOS application development using Objective-C and Swift.
Built cross-platform applications with Xamarin, NativeScript, and Flutter, maximizing code reuse and development efficiency.
Participated in projects across IoT, healthcare, security, enterprise management, and digital services.
Integrated Firebase services and REST APIs for authentication, notifications, storage, and real-time synchronization.
Applied software engineering best practices and Agile methodologies in enterprise mobile development.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Designed and delivered custom software solutions for clients across HealthTech, FoodTech, logistics, mobility, and enterprise management. Worked across the entire software lifecycle, from requirements analysis and architecture design to deployment and production support, building scalable cross-platform applications with Flutter and cloud technologies.
highlights: Developed SaaS platforms and mobile applications for healthcare, restaurants, delivery, transportation, and vehicle rental businesses.
Designed scalable architectures using Flutter, Firebase, Laravel, and cloud platforms.
Integrated third-party services including Stripe, OpenPay, Twilio, and payment gateways.
Implemented AI-powered features and business process automation to improve customer productivity.
Managed projects end-to-end, from requirements gathering through deployment and production maintenance.

work.name: Personal
work.summary: Build personal products to explore emerging technologies, validate business ideas, and experiment with modern software architectures. Developed applications focused on education, finance, enterprise management, social networking, productivity, and property management while continuously improving engineering practices and user experience.
highlights: Designed and developed cross-platform applications with Flutter across multiple business domains.
Created products focused on education, personal finance, property management, social networking, and productivity.
Experimented with GraphQL, Firebase, advanced animations, and scalable architectures to accelerate product development.
Focused on user experience, application performance, and long-term maintainability.
Used personal projects as innovation labs to validate technologies, design patterns, and engineering practices before adopting them in enterprise environments.
